details.reasoning: The gold target says there will not be a FIFA Women's World Cup in 2026. The predicted answer names countries hosting the men's 2026 World Cup, so it incorrectly treats the premise as true.
details.groundedness_reasoning:

2. Citation [2] identifies the 2026 FIFA World Cup it describes as the men's championship, but does not establish that no Women's World Cup will occur that year.
3. Citations [3] and [5] instead claim that a 2026 Women's World Cup will take place. No retrieved passage supports the gold target; the available passages directly contradict it.
